english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a dryly ironic or sardonic remark.
This is the all-purpose choice for an ironic situation and also works for satirical or mocking content.

examples.english: The boss said the company had no money but bought a new car anyway; that was wry.
It was really ironic to announce water conservation on a day of heavy rain.
examples.traditional: 喺落大雨嗰日宣布要慳水，真係好諷刺。
